labels.name: Anterior compartment
labels.function: Holds the ankle dorsiflexors and toe extensors

labels.name: Lateral compartment
labels.function: Holds the foot evertors (fibularis longus and brevis)

labels.name: Deep posterior compartment
accept: deep posterior compartment of the leg
labels.function: Holds tibialis posterior and the deep toe flexors

labels.name: Superficial posterior compartment
accept: superficial posterior compartment of the leg
labels.function: Holds gastrocnemius and soleus, the main plantar flexors

labels.name: Tibia
labels.function: Its fracture is the classic cause of leg compartment syndrome

labels.name: Fibula
labels.function: Slender bone that the intermuscular septa attach to

labels.name: Interosseous membrane
labels.function: Sheet joining the two leg bones; walls off compartments

labels.name: Deep (crural) fascia
labels.function: Inelastic envelope; divided in fasciotomy to relieve pressure

labels.name: Quadriceps
labels.function: Strained by forceful contraction; prone to deep contusion

labels.name: Hamstrings
labels.function: Strained in sprinting; rupture weakens hip extension, knee flexion

labels.name: Femur
labels.function: Bone against which blunt trauma crushes the overlying muscle

labels.name: Intramuscular hematoma
labels.function: Bleed from blunt trauma; can turn mesenchymal cells into osteoblasts

labels.name: Patellar tendon
labels.function: Rupture prevents active knee extension

labels.name: Gastrocnemius
labels.function: Calf muscle often strained by eccentric overload

labels.name: Achilles tendon
labels.function: Rupture weakens plantar flexion

labels.name: Mature lamellar bone (periphery)
labels.function: Outer zone; peripheral calcification unlike osteosarcoma

labels.name: Immature fibroblastic tissue (center)
labels.function: Inner zone; can mimic osteosarcoma if biopsied early

labels.name: Na+/K+-ATPase
labels.function: Energy-dependent pump; failure lets ions and water in, swelling the cell

labels.name: Intracellular calcium
labels.function: Accumulates when ATP runs out; activates degradative enzymes

labels.name: Proteases and phospholipases
labels.function: Digest cell proteins and membranes, causing necrosis

labels.name: Sarcolemma
labels.function: Breach lets the cell's contents leak into the blood

labels.name: Creatine kinase
labels.function: Most reliable marker; over 5x normal; half-life about 36 h

labels.name: Myoglobin
labels.function: Heme pigment: cola urine, dipstick blood without RBCs

labels.name: Potassium
labels.function: Released cation that can cause fatal arrhythmias

labels.name: Phosphate
labels.function: Released anion that rises in serum with cell breakdown

labels.name: Renal tubule
labels.function: Pigment casts and direct injury here cause AKI
